data: Is the value of the blue dot at epoch 4 in the middle plot lower than that of the blue dot at epoch 3 in the same plot?

The middle plot represents the False Abusive Rate. The blue dots represent the values at different epochs. At epoch 3, the blue dot is positioned above the blue dot at epoch 4. Therefore, the value of the blue dot at epoch 4 is lower than that of the blue dot at epoch 3.
